verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas's own `create-playcanvas` scaffolds TypeScript projects for the Engine, which implies typed API definitions an editor can use. There is also an official VS Code extension for editing scripts locally. Neither item explicitly documents typed definitions, completions, diagnostics, navigation or a language server. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented official LSP or shipped type declarations, documented completion/diagnostic/navigation behavior, and independent corroboration of editor tooling quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the scripting language has first-class machine tooling — an official language server (LSP) or typed API definitions a coding agent's editor can attach to for completions, diagnostics, and navigation

citations.quote: Use `create-playcanvas` to scaffold a Vite and TypeScript project for the Engine, React, or Web Components from one of 12 runnable starters.
Edit its scripts locally with the VS Code extension
